title: King Kisra Anushirwan and the Village Damsel
logline: A thirsty king is served sugarcane juice by a village girl whose single stalk fills a bowl; when he secretly decides to raise the village tax the cane runs dry, and her plain explanation makes him drop the plan and marry her.
moral: A ruler's intentions reach the land and its people; honest words from the humblest person can turn a king.
tone: Warm, gently comic folk tale with one moment of real shame; dramatic irony throughout (we know who he is and what he is thinking, she does not).

beats.summary: The king out hunting gallops after a gazelle and loses his men.
Parched, he sees a small village and stops at the nearest house to ask for water.
A girl wrings ONE sugarcane stalk: it fills the bowl. She adds water and a pinch of scented powder.
Dramatic irony: she serves a dusty stranger; only we see the crown in his saddlebag.
The powder forces him to sip; he asks why it is there.
Her answer: he was so thirsty that gulping it all at once would have hurt him. First proof of her wisdom.
How many stalks? Only one. He is amazed at the rich land.
He checks the village tax in his register: small. Greed stirs.
In his thought cloud the coin pile grows: he will raise the tax. Behind him one cane leaf droops, unseen.
That evening he returns by the same road and asks for another drink.
This time she is slow; the king waits and wonders.
Three stalks gave less than the single stalk of the morning.
Her explanation, said innocently to the ruler himself: good shrinks when a ruler means to wrong his people.
The king understands: his own tax plan dried the cane. Shame.
He tears up the tax plan; the cane springs back.
He puts on the crown (she learns who he is) and marries her.
A village girl's words changed a king's decision.

scenes.summary: Moral tableau: a village girl's words changed a king's decision. THE END.

actions.acting: villagers sq 0.94, look up worried

actions.action: the ghost sack swells once
actions.acting: child hides behind the woman

subtitles.ar: خرج الملك أنوشروان العادل للصيد،|وابتعد عن رجاله وهو يطارد غزالًا.|اشتد عطشه في الطريق، فرأى قرية صغيرة،|ووقف عند بيت قريب يسأل أهله عن ماء يشربه قبل أن يكمل رحلته.
subtitles.en: King Anushirwan became separated from his hunting party|while chasing a deer.|Thirsty, he stopped at a village house|and asked for a drink.

subtitles.ar: خرجت فتاة من البيت، ثم عادت وعصرت عودًا واحدًا من قصب السكر في إناء،|ومزجت العصير بالماء.|وضعت فوقه مسحوقًا عطريًا خفيفًا،|وقدمت الشراب للضيف الذي لم تعرف أنه الملك.
subtitles.en: A young woman squeezed one stalk of sugarcane into a bowl,|diluted it with water,|added a little scented powder|and served the stranger.

subtitles.ar: شرب أنوشروان على مهل، وأعجبه الطعم،|لكنه سأل الفتاة عن سبب وضع المسحوق الذي جعله لا يشرب بسرعة.|أجابته أنها رأته شديد العطش،|وخافت أن يبتلع الماء كله دفعة واحدة فيؤذيه.
subtitles.en: He enjoyed the drink|but asked about the powder.|She said his thirst was so great|she wanted him to sip slowly instead of swallowing it all at once.

subtitles.ar: سر الملك بحكمتها، وسألها عن عدد أعواد القصب التي استعملتها.|قالت إنها استخدمت عودًا واحدًا فقط.|تعجب من وفرة العصير،|ثم نظر في مقدار الضرائب المفروضة على القرية، ووجدها قليلة.
subtitles.en: Impressed by her thoughtfulness, he asked how many stalks she had used.|Only one, she replied.|Seeing the village’s low taxes,|he considered raising them.

subtitles.ar: فكر الملك في زيادة الضرائب عند عودته إلى قصره،|لأن الأرض تبدو شديدة الخصوبة.|مضى في صيده، ثم رجع من الطريق نفسه مساءً،|وتوقف عند بيت الفتاة ليطلب شرابًا آخر.
subtitles.en: The king decided he might raise the taxes|on such fertile land.|Later that day he returned along the same road|and asked the young woman for another drink.

subtitles.ar: تأخرت الفتاة هذه المرة، فسألها عن السبب.|قالت إن عودًا واحدًا لم يعطها عصيرًا يكفي، فاستعملت ثلاثة أعواد،|ومع ذلك لم تحصل على مقدار العصير الذي خرج من العود الأول صباحًا.
subtitles.en: This time she took much longer.|She explained that even three stalks|had yielded less juice than the single stalk that morning.

subtitles.ar: سألها الملك عن تفسير ذلك،|فقالت إن الخير يقل عندما ينوي الحاكم ظلم الناس،|وإن الأرض تتأثر بسوء حكمه.|فهم الملك كلامها، وتذكر أنه كان قد عزم على زيادة الضرائب على أهل القرية.
subtitles.en: Asked why,|she said prosperity weakens|when a ruler turns against his people.|The king remembered his own intention to increase their taxes.

subtitles.ar: ترك أنوشروان فكرة زيادة الضرائب،|وأعجب بذكاء الفتاة وجرأتها، فتزوجها كما تروي الحكاية.|وهكذا غيّرت كلمات فتاة من قرية صغيرة قرار ملك كان يستطيع أن يزيد العبء على أهلها.
subtitles.en: Anushirwan abandoned the tax increase|and, the tale says, married the clever young woman.|Her words had changed a powerful ruler’s decision.

new_assets.name: sugarcane (with caneField)
new_assets.description: The only major new drawing. sugarcane(ctx, x, baseY, {h: 360, w: 22, lush: 0..1, bend, sway, t, seed}): an upright stalk of 8 segments (alternating #9bc53d and #86b52f, black node rings 4 thick, black brush outline), slightly zigzag (2 units per node), topped by 5 leaf blades 120 long drawn as tapering green strokes. lush 1: 22 wide, bright, leaves up at 40 to 70 degrees. lush 0: 13 wide, colour mixed toward #c9a544, leaves hanging below horizontal, the top third bowed over by bend (radians, up to 0.9). Loose piece: {cut: true, len: 220, rot, twist: 0..1, limp}: twist narrows the middle to 55 % and draws 4 diagonal wring lines; limp lets the two ends hang. caneField(ctx, x0, x1, baseY, {n: 7, h, lush (number or per-stalk array), bend (array), sway, t, seed}) draws n stalks with seeded heights (+/- 8 %) and a row of short green tufts at the base. Reusable for any farm, sugar, reed or bamboo scene (palette option).
new_assets.implementation: Polyline spine from the base to the tip with the bend applied to the upper third (rotate successive segments), each segment a rounded rect along the spine; leaves as K brush strokes from the top node with angle = mixed(up, down, lush) + sway * sin(t * 1.3 + seed). Colours with mixHex(green, yellow-brown, 1 - lush). Juice from Library drops() with colour #d8e36a. Pure function of the fields; the scene keys lush and bend with kfn and stagger(i).

new_assets.name: smallBowl
new_assets.description: Planned smallBowl (reuse the name) at 3x with fields fill 0..1, cut (cross-section showing the level), specks 0..1 (6 to 10 dark dots floating on the surface), tilt, colour of the liquid.
new_assets.implementation: Half ellipse body with a rim ellipse; with cut:true clip the near wall and fill the liquid polygon to fill * depth; specks from K.rng(seed).

new_assets.name: waterJug
new_assets.description: Planned ewer 60 x 110 with tilt and a pour arc.
new_assets.implementation: As planned by AN-107; pour arc with Library drops() along a parabola from the spout to the bowl.

new_assets.name: scroll, coinPile, crownProp, saddlebag
new_assets.description: Planned small props reused under their planned names: the tax scroll (open, torn and stamped states, house and coin icons), the coin pile in the thought cloud (n 3..40), the gold crown in two sizes, the saddlebag behind the saddle with the crown tips showing.
new_assets.implementation: Flat shapes; torn state = the scroll drawn twice with a zigzag clip on either side, each half on its own fall path with swing().

new_assets.name: person costume 'caliph' crown:false
new_assets.description: Opt-in field that draws the caliph preset with its turban and jewel but without the crown, so a king can travel unrecognised and be revealed by putting the crown on. Default (crown undefined) is unchanged.
new_assets.implementation: One conditional around the crown drawing in cast/people.js; regression test must stay "all identical". If the owner prefers not to touch the library, use costume merchant with pal {robe: red, hc: white} until 156.4 instead.

new_assets.name: iconBalloon
new_assets.description: Planned wordless picture balloon, single and strip mode. Icons needed here: water drop, bowl (uses smallBowl with cut), cane stalk (uses sugarcane cut), thirsty face, struck state (red X), crown, tiny house, down arrow, less-than sign, morning ground (yellow with a small sun).
new_assets.implementation: White rounded balloon with a black brush outline and a tail to the speaker; frames are clipped cells that call the real prop functions at small scale, so the icons match the props.

new_assets.name: powderSprinkle
new_assets.description: A pinch of powder: 12 small dots falling from a hand point with slight sideways drift, landing as specks; plus two aroma curls (planned stinkLines in aroma mode).
new_assets.implementation: Dots from K.rng(seed) with fall time 0.5 s each, staggered over 1.2 s; pure function of t - t0.

new_assets.name: handOver
new_assets.description: Planned hand-over of an object between two people: both hands meet under the object, the giver releases after the receiver grips, the object dips 4 units at the transfer.
new_assets.implementation: World hand targets (handLW/handRW) for both figures driven by one object position function.

owner_questions: The cane field is used as a visible meter of the land's blessing: one leaf droops when the king plans the tax (93 s), the field thins by evening and springs back when he tears the plan up (151.8 s); the recovery is not in the script. Default: keep it.

The king travels without his crown (it rides in his saddlebag, shown to the audience at 2.2 s and 41 s) so the girl can plausibly not know him; he puts it on at 'فتزوجها' (156.4 s). Default: keep it; this needs the small library option crown:false on the caliph costume.
The king tears his tax register in two at 150.98 s as the picture of 'he abandoned the idea'. Default: keep it.
The wedding is shown lightly in the yard (he kneels and offers his hand, a small crown lands on her head, one heart) with no palace scene. Default: keep it simple.
The last scene adds three villagers and a dashed ghost TAX sack that pops, to picture 'the burden on her people'; the held ending has the horse stealing a bite of cane. Default: keep both.

English lettering added: KING ANUSHIRWAN, A VILLAGE!, A STRANGER?, SIP... SIP..., ONLY ONE!, RICH LAND!, TAX: SMALL, MORE TAX!, THAT EVENING..., THE KING!, NO NEW TAX!, THE END. Default: keep these twelve.

SCRIPT: the English translation is a condensed version of the Arabic (for example P2 omits that she came out and went back and did not know he was the king, P4 omits his amazement at the juice and says he 'considered raising them' which the Arabic only says in P5, P8 omits her courage and the last clause about the burden). Both are kept verbatim; default: no change.
implementation_notes: One yard set serves 12 of 16 scenes: bake it per state (morning u 0.10, evening u 0.47..0.55) and key only door, window, sky u and the cane field. Draw order: villageYard, caneField, hitching post, horse, king, girl, props, balloons, lettering, finish.

The cane field state is one function of time used by every yard scene: LUSH(t) = kfn(t, [[0, 1], [96.5, 1], [98.5, 0.3], [136.4, 0.3], [138, 0.15], [151.8, 0.15], [153.4, 1]]) with stagger(i) of 0.2 s per stalk, and BEND0(t) (the first leaf) from 92.4.

Cue every action from timing.json words; the cue times in this plan are the word starts on the final MP3. The narration has almost no pauses: the only real gaps are 1.06-1.48, 3.66-4.18, 21.38-21.88, 43.04-43.66, 94.48-94.98, 135.46-135.86 and 149.36-149.66, so only nine effects are planned, all inside those gaps or after the last word (170.2).
Dismounts and mounts are staged behind the horse (rider sinks out of the clipped rideOn figure, then a standing person walks out) because the person figure is front-facing with no profile.
Evening arrival is mirrored: the horse stands at x 880 facing left. Keep the king and girl marks unchanged so every two-shot matches the morning.

Thought cloud (S9, S15): thoughtCloud(ctx, 560, 330, 520, 380, t, {tail: [king head], scale: 0.42, at: [throne x, 700], inside}) with palaceHall, the king sitting crowned on the throne anchor (sit 1, seat 'bench') and coinPile beside the dais. In S15 the same call with a greyed fill.
Set LIFE.t = t each frame for automatic blinks; give explicit lid values hand blinks. King freeze at 133.66 uses noBlink for 1.5 s.
Balloons and labels go above or beside heads in the sky or over the cottage wall, never over a face; keep all faces and the bowl above world y 900 (the caption panel is below).
Subtitles: use the chunk marks in this plan; Arabic in Noto Naskh Arabic 700, English in blue Bangers below.
warnings: The narration is nearly continuous (no pause of 0.6 s or more), so sound effects are very sparse and short; do not add more.
S9 is 18.8 s on one set with a pan, an insert and the thought cloud: keep the pacing by cutting camera positions exactly on the listed words.

The silhouette acting in the lit window (104.9 to 106.1) is small (80 x 80 world units): at zoom 1.45 it is about 116 px; keep the motion broad (twist, look, reach) or enlarge the window to 110 x 100.
The girl must not recognise the king before 155.4; avoid any bow or deference from her earlier.
crown:false is a library change: run the regression test; a fallback without a library change is given in new_assets.
